goals.title: It looks like the einmo interface is still being updated. Let's Put the "how to run specific test cases" and "how to run a subset of tests" in a central location with examples. Then the FOOP plan making instruction will instruct the planner to write at the top of each sub-section/phase of a foop plan "- [ ] Establish relevant tests for this phase use [these instructions](link to the section of central documentation) to run einmo tests: case_1, foop-#/case_2, case3; run unit tests: case_a, case_b...;  in this fashion, we can make good plans right now, and when einmo updates, we can change the command more easily.
